The interceptor lives at `web/src/connect.ts` (lines 156–178). It attaches an access JWT as a `Bearer` header. The refresh token is sent via HTTP cookies through `refreshAuthClient.refreshToken()`, which intentionally avoids the auth interceptor to prevent recursion.

The interceptor triggers a refresh on 401 errors. It uses `getRequestToken()` to handle access token preflight refresh. The access token is kept in memory and localStorage. The refresh token is stored in an HTTP cookie.

The auth interceptor lives in `web/src/connect.ts`. It manages an access token for `Authorization: Bearer` headers and a refresh token via HttpOnly cookie. The backend package that validates these tokens is `backend/auth`.

The backend package path is `server/auth`.

The backend package validating frontend tokens is `server/auth`, or `github.com/usememos/memos/server/auth`.

The frontend auth interceptor lives in `web/src/connect.ts`. It manages a JWT access token and an HttpOnly refresh cookie. The backend package that validates these is `server/auth`.

The backend authenticator checks Bearer tokens, including Access Token V2 and PAT. The Connect AuthInterceptor delegates to Authorizer, which uses auth.Authenticator.

q29.

**`web/src/connect.ts`**; **JWT access token** (sent as `Authorization: Bearer`, stored in `web/src/auth-state.ts`) and **refresh token** (HttpOnly cookie, used via `credentials: "include"` when calling `refreshToken`); **`server/auth`**

Frontend API calls go through Connect RPC clients in `web/src/connect.ts`. The `authInterceptor` there calls `getRequestToken()` to attach a Bearer access token, proactively refreshes it when near expiry, and on `Unauthenticated` retries once after `refreshAccessToken()`. Refresh uses a separate transport without the interceptor and relies on the browser sending the refresh cookie. Token state lives in `web/src/auth-state.ts` (access token in memory/localStorage; refresh token is cookie-only).

On the backend, `server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go` defines `AuthInterceptor`, which delegates to `Authorizer.Authenticate()` and ultimately `server/auth.Authenticator.Authenticate()` in `server/auth/authenticator.go`. That package validates JWT access tokens and personal access tokens from the `Authorization` header (`server/auth/token.go`).
